Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, sys
for idx, f in enumerate(os.listdir('suite/fuzz/corpus')):
    p='suite/fuzz/corpus/'+f
    r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm', p], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if r.returncode!=0 or b'WARNING: MemorySanitizer' in r.stderr or b'use-of-uninitialized' in r.stderr:
        print('FOUND', idx, p, 'rc', r.returncode)
        print(r.stderr[:2000].decode('latin1','replace'))
        sys.exit(0)
    if idx%1000==0: print('checked',idx, file=sys.stderr)
print('none')
PY
